soundness.checkable_by: Specify the objects, domains, allowed operations, exact conclusion, boundary conditions and faithful interpretation; provide a complete proof or reproducible test. The main claim concerns a specific 188-axiom theory, but the file does not enumerate the axioms or give a formal derivation system, model language, or semantics for all referenced domains. Encoding only a generic abstract consistency statement would not check META-1's actual claim, and encoding just DAG acyclicity or a toy model would be an unfaithful side calculation.
